items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Bessie, she was up there at Carney's Inn. And she'd get in a high and start crying, and say, Tom, give me ten dollars... What, did Bessie Smith say that to you? Yeah.

ctx.x: He said that, he told me that. I'm glad to hear you verify that.

Yeah, he had Mamie Smith and then Bessie Smith come on, see. And he couldn't use Bessie Smith, but he'd give her a dollar -- $100, I mean, for -- Bessie was an original, she was an original blues singer.
